To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a two-photon Fock state wave packet interacting with the JC system undergoes transformation of the 2PJs, the scattered photons become frequency entangled while the incident photons remain uncorrelated.

the two-photon Fock state wave packet, propagating in a waveguide coupled to a JC atom-cavity system, is transformed by the interaction with the JC system, and the transformation is characterized by the entanglement of the scattered photons.

the interaction of the two-photon wave-packet with the cavity-atom system leads to a transformation of the wave-packet spectrum, the generation of frequency-entangled photon pairs and the excitation of the atom.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the exact quantum description of the dynamics of a two-photel wave packet interacting with an atom in the Jaynes-Cummins system.
the exact quantum state dynamics of a two-photons wave packet interacting with the JC system.
the quantum state dynamics of a two-photons wave packet interacting with an atom in a cavity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the two-photon Fock state wave packet is an excellent candidate to study the dynamics of quantum systems.
the interaction between the wave packet and the JC system is a source of frequency entanglement of scattered photons.
our approach allows us to study the quantum state evolution of the system under investigation, and thus it can be used to investigate other quantum-optics phenomena.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have provided an efficient tool to investigate the quantum state dynamics of the waveguide-atom system and to analyze the effect of the atom-cavity coupling on the two-photon wave-packet evolution.
the two-photon wave packets can be employed for quantum state engineering of the JC system.
we have developed an exact wave packet formalism for the study of the interaction of few-photon pulses with a cavity-atomic system.

the wave packet can be used to probe the JC system and its dynamics, and that the JC system can be used to manipulate the wave packet and to generate frequency entanglement between photons in the wave packet.
